description: For a source dynaset and then a source snapshot over F: open it, set Filter "N > 20" and Sort "N DESC", call OpenRecordset with the type argument omitted, dbOpenSnapshot, dbOpenDynaset, dbOpenForwardOnly and dbOpenTable in turn; on each derived recordset read Type, Updatable, Filter, Sort, walk ID and N by MoveNext to EOF, read RecordCount; close it and the source. Asks the type, updatability, inherited properties and rows of the derived recordset per source type and requested type, and which requests are refused. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
